_comment: Copy to profile.local.json (git-ignored) and edit: `python buyer_profile.py --init`. With no profile.local.json the tool keeps the repo owner's defaults. purpose: own_stay | investment. buyer_type: SC | PR | Foreigner (drives ABSD). property_count: Singapore residential properties already owned (0 = this is the first). household_citizenship: SC if at least one applicant is a Singapore Citizen (needed for a NEW EC), PR for a PR-only household (resale EC after MOP only). mandates[].property_types: condo and/or ec. anchors.workplace_postal: 6-digit postal code for commute times (needs OneMap credentials, see utils/onemap.py).
name: example buyer
